# Incident with Actions

## What Changed

Oct 22, 15:18 UTC Resolved - On October 22, 2026, from 13:05 to 15:20 UTC, our event streaming platform was degraded resulting in elevated job processing latency spikes of 19-35 seconds and elevated job processing times of 4m – this resulted in delayed Actions workflow and step results (up to 13m), notifications (20m) and repository push events (12m). Recovery for repositories began at 14:32, with Actions recovery beginning at 14:59. The issue reoccurred at 16:26 again impacting Actions runs, repo push events, and notifications. Recovery began at 17:16 and completed at 2:07. The incident was caused by a significant increase in load coupled with client connection storms during a deployment overloading our Kafka event streaming brokers. To prevent future recurrence, we have expanded the affected cluster, shifted traffic to less loaded clusters, and implemented tunable client reconnect backoff. Oct 22, 15:18 UTC Update - GitHub Actions workflow and step result processing has recovered. Repository update processing has also returned to normal. Oct 22, 15:17 UTC Monitoring - The degradation affecting Actions has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Oct 22, 15:06 UTC...

## Why It Matters to a CSA

Service degradation can affect delivery confidence and operational readiness.
